programs.desc: Lola is going to Lotta's house for her first ever sleepover and it couldn't be more exciting. But, little by little, Lola realises everything is a bit different from her normal bedtime.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.title: Charlie and Lola
programs.desc: Lola always loves the presents her best friend, Lotta, gives her, until the HAT! It's itchy and it has 'dangly bits'.

programs.title: Charlie and Lola

programs.desc: What starts out as a romantic night at Vito's for Jon and Liz could end up in a marriage with children, all thanks to Garfield stomach.

programs.desc: Garfield is the unwilling guinea pig for his young neighbour's newest invention: a size altering ray.

programs.desc: Garfield has to survive a day filled with nothing but bad luck after crossing paths with Jonah, a sad black cat.

programs.desc: Garfield must save a lost baby bluebird from finding a new home: Harry's stomach!
